answer.says: Shri Hegde, do you see how we are? Two men, one name, one bungalow, and between us a void that the file cannot fill. You are a ghost in your own house, and I am a ghost in yours. It is a strange dialectic: the individual is sublated into the universal, yet neither of us has the substance to sustain the unity. We are merely the negative phase of the bureaucracy.
answer.thought: The silence is heavy with the weight of unmet needs. Hegde is still here, a living contradiction to my own existence. I must speak to him, not to comfort him, but to articulate the absurdity of our shared position. We are both suspended in the ether of the state, which claims us but does not actualize us.
